title: A Multidisciplinary Investigation of Cardiovascular Benefits of Wild Rice
official: A Multidisciplinary Investigation of Cardiovascular Benefits of Wild Rice
summary: In this study 24 adult males and adult females, with overall healthy condition, will consume approximately 30 grams of wild rice every day for 28 days. Cardiovascular risk factors will be assessed at the beginning and at the end of the study.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Male
* Female
* Both genders are healthy
* 20 - 40 years old

Exclusion Criteria:

* Non-pregnant
* Non-lactating
* Non-smokers
* Not obese (Body Mass Index (BMI) \< 30)
* Not currently on any medications for cardiovascular, diabetes, and cancer diseases
